unusual_formatting: Iron Giant and Torama include prose between the Stats heading and the structured infobox; the Stats infobox was still extracted.
Some roster entries are distinct display variants that share a Fandom page URL; they remain separate roster records.

The Chocobo World section repeats four existing enemy pages and includes Demon King; the repeated pages are represented as separate roster records, while Demon King is explicitly unresolved because its page has no Stats section.
